format: html

---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
data <- read.csv("billboard100.csv")
```

```{r}
head(data, 10)
```

```{r}
songs <- data %>% select(song, artist)
head(songs, 5)
```

```{r}
position <- data %>% select(rank, last.week, peak.rank)
head(position, 5)
```

```{r}
data %>% select(contains("rank")) 
```

Vyber pouze skladby, které jsou v Top 10.

```{r}
data %>% select(rank, song) %>% filter(rank <= 10) 
```

Vyber pouze skladby interpreta `"Taylor Swift"`.

```{r}
data %>% filter(artist == "Taylor Swift") %>% select(song) %>% distinct()
```
